CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation linked to identified content/organization found.

COD.rationale: Content coordinates (red) and a separate origin/organization field are both explicitly provided for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim tied to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify 'red' with coordinate sets for current-record referents.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content coordinates and an origin/organization/status field for the same referent, distinguishing identification from provenance/organization.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/organization fields describe how the listed content is presented or derived (copied_prior_record, inherited_current, history_estimate) for current and candidate records.
